reference_recording.result: Actual Qt SpeedAndMemoryPanel byte/time setters and UpdateOptions record five byte/unit/time pairs, untouched loaded 1,048,577-byte normalization and raw 299-second preservation, and a real edited TimeDeltaWidget focus-out minimum of 300 seconds. A detached real DataCache receives synthetic uncompressed HydrusBitmap buffers under a controlled monotonic clock for 18 add/get/touch/maintenance/policy/clear events. The actual running thumbnail cache NotifyNewOptions receives size 100 and timeout 300, then prior options are restored. The actual nested Help debug memory-action QAction publishes clear_thumbnail_cache; at that publication boundary its real existing ThumbnailCache.Clear executes synchronously and publishes notify_complete_thumbnail_reset. The expanded actual Qt controls PNG was inspected.
reference_recording.environment_notes: Reference startup reports sandbox-denied client API socket listening and ordinary offscreen Qt warnings. Targeted recording completed with fixture and PNG. The detached cache substitutes only its module-local time namespace; no global time monkeypatch, production network/process launch or other cache-clear action is performed.

limits: Exactly three original frozen Missing leaves receive bounded first-pass proposals. Speed and Memory, thumbnail-cache and Help/debug parents remain Partial; no alias/new ID, image/tile/prefetch/video cache or other debug action is counted.

Reference ThumbnailCache is process-wide. Native cache is owned by one main GUI incarnation and shared across its pages; separate main windows do not share raster entries. Apply updates the currently owned cache immediately. Rebind and accepted exit retire rows and cancel their staged Options owner, while declined exit preserves both.

Native cache accounts decoded RGB/RGBA buffer bytes and 128 bytes for a missing-thumbnail entry. Reference HydrusBitmap may store compressed data. Renderer-held image clones, loader queues, metadata/icon caches and total process/GPU memory are outside this finite accounted budget. As in reference, admission may overflow by one incoming entry until maintenance; this is not a hard total-memory ceiling.

Timeout uses monotonic last access and strict older-than expiry. Existing 25ms owned main collection ticks perform maintenance without requiring a new thumbnail request. Native inline day/hour/minute editing preserves untouched raw 299 seconds and enforces 300 seconds once edited; the reference duration-popup geometry remains outside this slice.
